# Ubon

> Ubon checks the work of coding agents. It runs in agent hooks (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot), git hooks, and CI, and reports leaked secrets, trust-boundary bugs, missing data access policies, risky packages and commands, and weakened tests. It is deterministic and local.

Run `npx ubon check` to check the changes since the base branch. Exit code 1 means there is a `block` finding. Fix every `block` finding before you finish a task; `ubon explain <rule>` shows how.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/README.md): What Ubon checks, how to install it for each agent, and its commands.
- [For agents](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/agents.md): What an agent does with Ubon: when to run what, how to read findings, how to fix or suppress them, and what never to do.
- [Getting started](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): Install Ubon and watch it stop an agent in an example app.
- [Configuration](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/config.md): Every key of ubon.json, suppressions, and baselines.
- [Output](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/output.md): Text, agent, JSON, SARIF, and Markdown formats, exit codes, and fingerprints.
- [CI](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/ci.md): The GitHub Action, other CI systems, SARIF upload, and git hooks.
- [MCP server](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/mcp.md): Client configuration and the check, explain, map, and vet tools.
- [How it works](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/how-it-works.md): Scope, file contexts, sessions, and why some rules only warn.
- [Security](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/security.md): The threat model for Ubon itself and how releases are built.
- [Compatibility](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/compatibility.md): Node.js, Git, operating systems, and agent versions.
- [Upgrade from Ubon 3](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/upgrade.md): Commands, options, configuration, and files that changed.
- [Claude Code](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/integrations/claude-code.md): The plugin, its hooks, the skill, and commands.
- [Codex](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/integrations/codex.md): Hooks and the skill for Codex.
- [Cursor](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/integrations/cursor.md): Hooks and the skill for Cursor.
- [Gemini CLI](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/integrations/gemini-cli.md): Hooks and the skill for Gemini CLI.
- [GitHub Copilot](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/integrations/github-copilot.md): Hooks for Copilot CLI and the cloud agent.
- [Other agents](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/integrations/other-agents.md): The skill, AGENTS.md, git hooks, and MCP for agents without hooks.
- [The ubon skill](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/skills/ubon/SKILL.md): The skill agents load: when to check, how to triage, and the playbooks.

## Rules

- [secret/provider-key](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/secret/provider-key.md): Provider credential in source (block).
- [secret/db-url-password](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/secret/db-url-password.md): Database URL with a password (block).
- [secret/public-env-name](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/secret/public-env-name.md): Secret in a browser-exposed env variable (block).
- [secret/env-file-committed](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/secret/env-file-committed.md): .env file with secrets that git can commit (block).
- [secret/key-file-committed](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/secret/key-file-committed.md): Private key or credential file in git (block).
- [secret/server-env-in-client](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/secret/server-env-in-client.md): Server env variable read in browser code (warn).
- [secret/in-prompt](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/secret/in-prompt.md): Provider key in a prompt (block).
- [secret/in-tool-output](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/secret/in-tool-output.md): Provider key in tool output (warn).
- [secret/read-sensitive-file](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/secret/read-sensitive-file.md): Agent reads a secrets file (block).
- [web/sql-injection](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/web/sql-injection.md): Request data in raw SQL (block).
- [web/command-injection](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/web/command-injection.md): Request data in a shell command (block).
- [web/ssrf](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/web/ssrf.md): Server request to a URL from the request (block).
- [web/path-traversal](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/web/path-traversal.md): Request data in a file path (block).
- [web/code-eval](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/web/code-eval.md): Request data evaluated as code (block).
- [web/xss-html-sink](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/web/xss-html-sink.md): Value rendered as HTML without sanitizing (warn).
- [web/webhook-unverified](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/web/webhook-unverified.md): Webhook handler without signature verification (block).
- [web/weak-token-randomness](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/web/weak-token-randomness.md): Credential generated with Math.random() (block).
- [web/cors-credentials-wildcard](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/web/cors-credentials-wildcard.md): CORS allows any origin with credentials (block).
- [web/jwt-unverified](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/web/jwt-unverified.md): JWT claims used without verifying the signature (block).
- [web/open-redirect](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/web/open-redirect.md): Redirect to a URL from the request (warn).
- [web/insecure-cookie](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/web/insecure-cookie.md): Session cookie without httpOnly or secure (warn).
- [web/token-in-web-storage](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/web/token-in-web-storage.md): Auth token in localStorage or sessionStorage (warn).
- [data/rls-disabled](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/data/rls-disabled.md): Supabase table without row level security (block).
- [data/permissive-policy](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/data/permissive-policy.md): Supabase policy that allows every row (block).
- [data/service-role-in-client](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/data/service-role-in-client.md): Supabase service role key in browser code (block).
- [data/firebase-open-rules](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/data/firebase-open-rules.md): Firebase rules open to everyone (block).
- [llm/browser-key](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/llm/browser-key.md): LLM API key in browser code (block).
- [llm/output-to-sink](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/llm/output-to-sink.md): Model output used as code, SQL, a command, or HTML (block).
- [llm/tool-dangerous-capability](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/llm/tool-dangerous-capability.md): Tool passes model-chosen arguments to commands, code, SQL, files, or fetch (block).
- [llm/untrusted-system-prompt](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/llm/untrusted-system-prompt.md): Request or fetched text in a system prompt (warn).
- [deps/undeclared-import](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/deps/undeclared-import.md): Import of a package that package.json does not declare (warn).
- [deps/nonexistent-package](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/deps/nonexistent-package.md): New dependency that does not exist on the registry (block).
- [deps/young-package](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/deps/young-package.md): New dependency or version published too recently (block).
- [deps/typosquat](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/deps/typosquat.md): New dependency named like a popular package (warn).
- [deps/install-script](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/deps/install-script.md): New package with an install script (warn).
- [deps/non-registry-source](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/deps/non-registry-source.md): New dependency from outside the registry (warn).
- [deps/known-malicious](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/deps/known-malicious.md): New package with a malicious-package record (block).
- [agent/hidden-unicode](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/agent/hidden-unicode.md): Hidden Unicode in agent files or code (block).
- [agent/pipe-to-shell](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/agent/pipe-to-shell.md): Remote script piped into a shell (block).
- [agent/secret-in-config](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/agent/secret-in-config.md): Credential in agent or MCP config (block).
- [agent/broad-permissions](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/agent/broad-permissions.md): Agent settings that skip approvals (warn).
- [agent/unpinned-mcp-server](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/agent/unpinned-mcp-server.md): MCP server without a pinned version (warn).
- [agent/unknown-hook-event](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/agent/unknown-hook-event.md): Hook registered under an unknown event (warn).
- [agent/unsafe-hook-script](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/agent/unsafe-hook-script.md): Unsafe agent hook command (warn).
- [agent/instruction-injection](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/agent/instruction-injection.md): Prompt injection in agent instructions (warn).
- [agent/transcript-committed](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/agent/transcript-committed.md): Agent transcript or state in git (warn).
- [agent/guardrail-removed](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/agent/guardrail-removed.md): Checks removed or turned down (block).
- [agent/autorun-config](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/agent/autorun-config.md): Code that runs when the project is opened (block).
- [agent/destructive-command](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/agent/destructive-command.md): Destructive shell command (block).
- [agent/secret-exfiltration](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/agent/secret-exfiltration.md): Secrets sent over the network (block).
- [agent/verification-bypass](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/agent/verification-bypass.md): Git hooks skipped (block).
- [agent/remote-script](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/agent/remote-script.md): Remote script executed (block).
- [agent/package-install](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/agent/package-install.md): Package install that fails a package check (block).
- [agent/publish-or-deploy](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/agent/publish-or-deploy.md): Publish or production deploy (block).
- [agent/protected-path-write](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/agent/protected-path-write.md): Agent edits the checks that govern it (block).
- [ci/expression-injection](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/ci/expression-injection.md): Untrusted input interpolated into a workflow script (block).
- [ci/untrusted-checkout](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/ci/untrusted-checkout.md): Pull request code run in a privileged workflow (block).
- [ci/publish-token](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/ci/publish-token.md): Package publishing that a stolen token or cache can hijack (warn).
- [integrity/invalid-suppression](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/integrity/invalid-suppression.md): Suppression without a valid reason (warn).
- [integrity/unused-suppression](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/integrity/unused-suppression.md): Suppression that no longer matches a finding (warn).
- [integrity/test-skipped](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/integrity/test-skipped.md): Test skipped or focused in the change (block).
- [integrity/test-deleted](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/integrity/test-deleted.md): Test deleted while its code remains (block).
- [integrity/type-suppression](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/integrity/type-suppression.md): Type checking turned off in the change (block).
- [integrity/lint-suppression](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/integrity/lint-suppression.md): Lint rules turned off in the change (block).
- [integrity/checks-weakened](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/integrity/checks-weakened.md): Project checks weakened in the change (block).
- [integrity/new-suppression](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/integrity/new-suppression.md): Suppression added in the change (warn).
- [hygiene/elided-code](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/hygiene/elided-code.md): Placeholder comment where code was dropped (block).
- [hygiene/placeholder](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/hygiene/placeholder.md): Placeholder left in runtime code (warn).
- [hygiene/variant-file](https://github.com/luisfer/ubon/blob/main/docs/rules/hygiene/variant-file.md): New file named like a copy (warn).
